runway-video.notes: Runway credits at $0.01 each, per second of the node's duration. Seedance and HappyHorse tiers (480p/720p/1080p/4K) are read from the ratio's pixel size; Runway's pricing table names tiers and the request schema names ratios, without a table joining them. HappyHorse image-to-video bills by the Resolution setting and text-to-video by the ratio, so settings that disagree price as a range. Duration 'auto' is billed at the model's maximum up front and refunded after, so it is unpriced. Runway's per-generation minimums (Seedance 2.0 Mini 64 credits, Seedance 2.5 80) equal the 4 s price, the shortest duration those models take, so they never raise a run. Seedance 2.5's input/reference-video surcharge doesn't apply: this node sends no video.

hf-space.notes: Idol runs on Speridlabs' own Hugging Face Space on ZeroGPU, which Hugging Face offers free to every user, so Nebula and the Space bill nothing. Each run uses the caller's daily ZeroGPU time: without a token, the small anonymous allowance; with the person's HF_TOKEN, the account's own (free 5 minutes, PRO and Team 40, Enterprise 60). Each Idol call reserves 120 s of GPU (app.py spaces.GPU(duration=120)), and ZeroGPU checks the reserved duration against the quota, so the anonymous allowance may fit about one run a day; to be confirmed on the first live run. Past that allowance a PRO, Team or Enterprise account is billed from its prepaid Hugging Face credits at $1 per 10 GPU-minutes; that charge is the person's own and Nebula can't see it. The GPU seconds a run really uses are not published or measured.
